g.text: Two concurrent claim attempts race for the same last unit --
Redis's single-threaded execution decides, not a lock.
the last unit remaining -- only one of these two calls can still see remaining > 0
Redis: tryClaim() -- the entire script runs as ONE atomic unit
return 0 -- no lock, no DB call
No application lock anywhere: Redis's single-threaded script execution IS the atomicity.
Two concurrent calls can never both observe remaining > 0 and both decrement past zero.
